description: Stolnik, the ghost of a feast steward in the hall of the underworld god, a gaunt pale ghostly old man in a rich red Polish zupan and a fur-trimmed robe, holding out a golden goblet bubbling with green poison, a sly smile, hollow glowing eyes, eerie and menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the ghost alone, no table, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture
